en.html:
Shut in her room, enjoying a good morning's sleep? Her routine used to be quite regular. Perhaps not anymore.

If that was the case, she did not seem likely to turn into Silver Star and run wild while I was away. I had been dragged along this far before properly considering it, and had wondered whether I should go straight back.

Whether this was really just for fun, who knew? With the Kubo of Horigoe, that question applied to practically everything.
For now, better go along with what she wanted.

ja.html:
部屋に閉じ篭もって朝寝を貪っているという事か？
　あれは規則正しい生活リズムを持っていたはずだが
……今は違うのかもしれない。

　ともあれそういう事なら、俺のいない間に銀星号と
なって暴れ出す恐れは無さそうだ。
　引っ張られるまま勢いでここまで来たものの、すぐ
に戻るべきではないのかと考えていたのだが。

　<ruby>遊び<rt>・・</rt></ruby>というのもどこまで本気かわからない――これ
は堀越公方の全てについて言えるが。
　ひとまず、彼女の意向に沿った方が良いだろう。

Chachamaru"Shall we find you somewhere to rest a little?"
Kageaki"I am all right. But Your Excellency... why have we come here?"
Muramasa"Exactly! Why was I stuck to the roof of a car all the way here, giving every person on the road something to gossip about?"

Kageaki"Today...?"
Chachamaru"Last event of the year. Tamura Challenge Cup day."

茶々丸「そりゃ呼んでねえのに無理矢理くっついて きたおめーさまだけですが。 　……お兄さん、今日が何日だか忘れた？」
景明「今日……？」
茶々丸「今年最後のイベント。 　タムラチャレンジカップの日だよ」

en.html:
Arre, yes.
With everything going on, I had forgotten completely. Today was the day.

The Tamura Challenge Cup was an annual Armor Race meet organized by Tamura Armor Industries and several other companies. Annual tradition, yes, though only a few years old. Not a very large event.

But the manufacturers' teams brought machines intended for next year's competition. So among fans, interest was very high.
Getting a seat—haan, I had struggled with that myself.

ja.html:
そういえば。
　多事多端の渦中、すっかり忘れ去っていたが、成程
今日はその当日だ。

　タムラチャレンジカップとは、田村甲業ほか数社が
主催する毎年恒例の――と言っても数年の歴史に過ぎ
ないが――<ruby>装甲競技<rt>アーマーレース</rt></ruby>大会である。
　規模としてはそう大きくもない。

　が、参加する各社のワークスチームは来年の勝負を
見据えた騎体を送り込んでくるため、<ruby>愛好家<rt>ファン</rt></ruby>の注目度
は非常に高かった。
　座席を取るため四苦八苦した経験が俺にもある。
